summary: fortinet.fortios in Ansible 11: a sanity_test.yaml for CI, GET-before-PUT/POST SET logic, Mantis changes, tokens removed from URLs for security, and support for ansible-core 2.17 and FortiOS 7.4.4 and 7.6.0.
questions: Does fortios still pass the API token in the URL?
Which FortiOS versions are supported in Ansible 11's fortios collection?

answer_card.title: fortinet.fortios changes in Ansible 11
answer_card.answer_md:
- Tokens are no longer put in URLs, for better security.
- SET sends a GET first, then a PUT or POST.
- Supports ansible-core 2.17 and FortiOS 7.4.4 and 7.6.0.
